text:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a clear owner/timeline for the customer-facing summary and status page language. who can own?
Dan O'Neill: I can take the status page blurb. propose publishing a short incident summary within 24-48h and a fuller external summary (with impacted customers list) within 5 business days.
Carlos Rivera: +1 on the timelines. also we should track recurring patterns flagged in the PM and include a section on mitigation progress in the 5-day summary.
Priya Nair: I can draft the 24-48h status page message. will need the incident timeline and customer impact numbers from Carlos.
Elaine Park: From a legal/comms POV: short summary ok to post quickly. for full RCA sharing we need customer consent if PII or contractual data is involved. I'll review once draft is up.
Maya Chen: Good. let's list action items and owners in this thread so we can close the loop.
Maya Chen: Action items i see:
- Status page short message (24-48h) -> owner: Priya
- Full external summary + impacted-customer list (5 business days) -> owner: Carlos
- Legal/comms review + consent check -> owner: Elaine
- Internal remediation tracker update + recurring-patterns note -> owner: Dan
- Postmortem action owner confirmations in Jira -> owner: Maya
Priya Nair: putting a quick status page draft below, feedback welcome:
```
[Major / Degraded] 2026-07-21: Intermittent inference errors affecting generation endpoints.
Impact: Some requests returned 5xx errors or timed out, affecting ~0.3% of requests during the window.
Status: We mitigated the immediate cause and routed traffic to fallbacks. A detailed update will follow within 5 business days.
```
Carlos Rivera: I like it. recommend adding: "Customers on Dedicated deployments may have experienced higher latency" — is that accurate?
Priya Nair: yes that matches our telemetry. i'll add that line.
Elaine Park: Add: "We are reviewing logs and will contact any customers whose data or SLAs were directly affected." That signals outreach and consent steps.
Maya Chen: who will own the outreach list? Carlos?
Carlos Rivera: I can assemble the impacted-customer list from analytics + billing filters. ETA: 2 business days for preliminary list, 5 days for confirmed list with outreach language.
Dan O'Neill: I'll add a short section in the full external summary about recurring incident pattern and mitigation roadmap (per the postmortem). need confirmation on which mitigations are already scheduled.
Maya Chen: I'll update the remediation tracker in Jira after this thread with owners/due dates. assigning follow-ups now:
- Priya: publish status page draft within 12h after final ack here
- Carlos: preliminary impacted-customer list in 2bd, final in 5bd
- Elaine: legal/comms signoff on external summary within 3bd
- Dan: draft recurring-patterns paragraph by EOD
- Maya: create Jira follow-ups and assign owners by EOD
Elaine Park: quick note: if we want to include a sanitized RCA excerpt publicly, use the template we discussed — remove internal IDs and any customer-identifying logs. I'll attach template in the comms channel after signoff.
ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-0721 recorded. Reminder set: external-summary-due-5bd -> 1790934234
Priya Nair: ack, posting status page draft in 45m. tagging @Elaine Park for signoff once updated.
Carlos Rivera: ack. i'll share the preliminary impacted list in this thread when ready.
Dan O'Neill: ack, will post recurring-patterns paragraph and mitigation timelines here by EOD.
Maya Chen: thanks all — i'll convert these into Jira tasks and ping owners. let's reconvene if anything slips. :thumbsup:
